title: Hannah Prays for a Baby
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm heart, and tonight Hannah pours out her whole heart in prayer: Willow prays with all her heart for her sick grandma.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Hannah prayed with her whole warm heart, and warm hearts are Willow’s gift. In Willow’s world today: Grandma is sick and can’t come to Sunday dinner. Willow feels a heavy, sad lump inside. At bedtime she kneels down, folds her arms, and tells Heavenly Father all about it, every bit. When she stands up, the heavy lump feels lighter. Just like Hannah at the temple, Willow learned that you can give Heavenly Father your whole heart, and He hears every word.
